findings.statement: A possible recurring contributor is delayed handling before centrifugation or processing: PANEL-0008253 (integrity 0.39) records a longer wait before centrifugation and a centrifuge-queue warning, while PANEL-0000434 (integrity 0.31) records delayed processing after receipt. This is a qualified hypothesis based on the inspected flagged panels, not proof for all 30 flagged panels.

The inspected usable comparison was better: PANEL-0001321 (integrity 0.80) had no site-reported handling issue, and its processing log showed routine receipt and analyzer checks without an exception. Thus the available comparison supports a handling-delay hypothesis more than a universal processing failure, but coverage was limited to the panels inspected.

The inspected flagged panels suggest a possible collection-to-processing delay: PANEL-0006009 (integrity 0.25) remained on the collection bench while the centrifuge was occupied and generated a warning that the collection-to-processing interval exceeded the usual limit. However, PANEL-0003574 (integrity 0.26) reported no collection handling issue, so the inspected evidence does not establish one consistent cause.

The inspected usable comparison, PANEL-0002491 (integrity 0.87), reported no handling issue and had routine receipt, rack, calibration, and assay-control records. This argues against attributing all SITE-004 flags to a persistent central-lab processing problem, although only a small subset was inspected.

The inspected flagged panels show mixed patterns: PANEL-0004383 (integrity 0.21) documents repositioning and repeat collection attempts, with a processing warning for a prolonged draw, while PANEL-0000512 (integrity 0.33) has no collection note and no corresponding handling exception in the inspected events. Collection difficulty is therefore a plausible contributor for some panels, but the available records are incomplete.

Usable comparisons were also documented: PANEL-0000151 (integrity 0.75) described routine collection with no unusual conditions, and PANEL-0001054 (integrity 0.70) explicitly reported no collection difficulty. Because equality with the 0.70 threshold is usable, these records provide some evidence that SITE-011's flagged panels are not uniformly explained by a site-wide collection or central-processing failure.
